a_known.scope: Known stationary spectral positions; no target proper motions used in associations or fits. All original pre-SE reference draws retained. Separate r/all samples until paired by physical identity. C0 here denotes an experimental high-SE support sensitivity, not the frozen adopted graph or blind-source accuracy.

a_09_00.scope: Whole held year excluded from every target band before association. Frozen r-anchor additions and independent no-NSC-r anchor route separated; non-r r magnitudes come from actual SDSS r and are labelled. All bands eligible by physical quality; object IDs never enter training association. One-to-one 1arcsec held matches and four displaced-position controls. Conditional residuals are not absolute dark-star PM truth.
a_09_00.limitations: Candidate counts only, not adopted reliable stars. Unknown identities/blends are not successes; native W0 shared-night errors are uncalibrated. Footprints of qualified exposures do not prove a faint target had sufficient SNR. Original object-index r acquisition selection remains. No adopted full catalogue until independent source/error/zero validation.

a_09_00.scope: Fixed geometric core center, first/last actual exposure per filter. Comparison against retrieved normalized measurement identities, not source truth or image completeness. Historical ndetr/r selection can suppress non-r discoveries; zero audit losses in a few exposures do not prove general completeness.

Post-fit stationary spectral positions identify source and individual training members; PM similarity never labels identity. Unknown members and nonspectral sources are not declared correct. Neighbor/deblend indicates suspicion, not image-level blend truth. Zero known errors in finite samples retains Wilson intervals. No source selection or fitting changed.
a_09_00.uncertainty_scope: Spectral-zero intervals resample objects only. Shared physical groups require separate uncertainty/zero certification; their common error cannot be averaged down by source count.

b_16_00.scope: Exact saved extra-source detection order, original W2 scale/floors and original reference graph replayed before analysis. Conditional robust-influence decomposition into native positions and C0 shifts by band/year. Mean contributions, including zeros for absent measurements, add to mean PM; medians do not add. Not causal, no QSO-tuned correction, no new adopted selection.
